انفصلوا (form VII)
# اِنْفَصَلُوا (infaṣalū) /in.fa.sˤa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# اِنْفَصِلُوا (infaṣilū) /in.fa.sˤi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
